society.skycraft.say.region.malabal_tor: Dense hothouse jungle, the Xylo River gorge, and strict Green Pact custom surround the Silvenar's root-hall and Falinesti's glades.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.1: Malabal Tor is the deep jungle of the north-west on the Xylo River, the Bosmer heartland that the Dominion reaches least.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.2: The city of Silvenar is a hidden court under hollowed root arches, where the Silvenar holds audience and the Green Lady trains.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.4: Here in Malabal Tor, the land is shaped by the steep 30-block gorge of the Xylo River, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.5: Watch the sky when steaming, rain-drenched understorey air sets in across Malabal Tor—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.6: Our people draw their living along the Xylo and its waterfalls, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.7: Don't stray far into lianas, giant ferns, wasps and spiders after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.8: The markets of Malabal Tor turn on bone-bow hunting and smokehouses, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.9: From the hidden court city under root arches, the watch-horns carry clear across deep wet humus in the north-western basin.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.10: Ask anyone in Malabal Tor who holds the reins and they'll point you to keepers of the people's voice.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of orthodox Meat Mandate observance.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.12: Tempers run sharp over the Green Lady's trial for a successor whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through Malabal Tor.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.13: Give a wide berth to ancient transformation glades—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.14: The elders still tell of Bosmer who once broke the Pact and were entombed in a tree, written into the stones of Malabal Tor.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.15: Between the steep 30-block gorge of the Xylo River and the north-western harbour mouth, there's no mistaking the borders of Malabal Tor.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.16: When steaming, rain-drenched understorey air sweeps over hanging roots and spray, even veteran guides keep to the northern summer site of the walking tree.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.17: Traders dealing in coastal shipping always pay their dues to Wood Orc clans living outside the Pact before unlashing a single bale.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.18: You can still see the mark of Bosmer who once broke the Pact and were entombed in a tree near Pact-breakers sealed in living wood, if you know where to look.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.19: Whether you answer to keepers of the people's voice or just haul bone-bow hunting and smokehouses, tension over Wood Orc timber cutting touches every hearth in Malabal Tor.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.20: At the shrines of the martial trials of the forest's champion, travelers leave offerings before crossing deep wet humus in the north-western basin.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.21: Out beyond the hidden court city under root arches, hanging roots and spray and ancient transformation glades test anyone who wanders off the beaten track.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.22: Every season in Malabal Tor is measured by steaming, rain-drenched understorey air and the flow of the Xylo and its waterfalls.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.23: The factors who handle bone-bow hunting and smokehouses say the Green Lady's trial for a successor has doubled the price of guards along the north-western harbour mouth.
society.skycraft.say.malabal_tor.24: No mason in Malabal Tor forgets Bosmer who once broke the Pact and were entombed in a tree when laying foundations over the steep 30-block gorge of the Xylo River.

society.skycraft.say.region.reapers_marc: Golden savanna knolls, gallery groves, and mixed Bosmer-Khajiit trade towns line Reaper's March from Arenthia to Rawl'kha.

society.skycraft.say.reapers_march.2: Bosmer and Khajiit share it under a truce renewed with a bone laid on a stone altar each generation.

society.skycraft.say.region.grahtwood: Beneath mile-high graht-oaks, Elden Root's great trunk carries both the Camoran throne and the southern diplomatic courts in its canopy.

society.skycraft.say.grahtwood.2: The Elden Tree rises over everything, a city in one trunk with the Camoran court and the Thalmor in its crown and the poor among its roots.
society.skycraft.say.grahtwood.3: Around it stand old Ayleid vaults the Thalmor's scholars are reopening, burial trees, timber-mammoth glades and the winter site of Falinesti.
society.skycraft.say.grahtwood.4: Here in Grahtwood, the land is shaped by the deepest humus soils in the central basin, and every traveler learns to read the ground.

society.skycraft.say.region.greenshade: Tidal root-lagoons, sea mists, and living branch-bridges link the port of Woodhearth to the Wilderking's silent glades in Greenshade.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.1: Greenshade is the wet, misty west where marsh, mangrove and graht-oak meet the Abecean Sea.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.2: Woodhearth is a city of rope bridges strung among tall coastal trees, a port the Pact allows to trade with Summerset and Senchal, with the poorest Bosmer and outsiders camped on the muddy ground below.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.3: The Wilderking, the forest's spirit-guardian, holds court in a hollow grove the living rarely find.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.4: Here in Greenshade, the land is shaped by subsided beaches and mangrove estuaries on the western sea, and every traveler learns to read the ground.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.5: Watch the sky when rolling salt fog off the Abecean sets in across Greenshade—it changes the roads in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.6: Our people draw their living along Gathongor's Mire and Verrant Morass, where water and road meet.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.7: Don't stray far into reeds, stranglers and hoarvors after dusk unless you carry steel and a steady lantern.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.8: The markets of Greenshade turn on shipping with Summerset and Senchal, and every caravan counts the weight twice.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.9: From the rope-bridge port city, the watch-horns carry clear across low peat-and-clay hollows inland.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.10: Ask anyone in Greenshade who holds the reins and they'll point you to high bridge tiers above the docks.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.11: Even in hard seasons, folk here keep the rites of the living spirit-throne of the western woods.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.12: Tempers run sharp over the forest guardian no longer answers the Spinners whenever the tax-scribes and patrols ride through Greenshade.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.13: Give a wide berth to groves of the Wilderking's corrupted servants—scavengers who go in rarely bring their packs back out.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.14: The elders still tell of the burning of the western Ayleid city, written into the stones of Greenshade.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.15: Between subsided beaches and mangrove estuaries on the western sea and sheltered harbour sound, there's no mistaking the borders of Greenshade.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.16: When heavy year-round rain sweeps over coastal mangrove roots, even veteran guides keep to a marsh town inside a hollow tree.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.17: Traders dealing in bay and estuary fisheries always pay their dues to the poorest of Valenwood on the mud floor before unlashing a single bale.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.18: You can still see the mark of each Wilderking chosen from a mortal host near burned Ayleid citadel, if you know where to look.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.19: Whether you answer to high bridge tiers above the docks or just haul shipping with Summerset and Senchal, sea-elf landings along the western coves touches every hearth in Greenshade.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.20: At the shrines of story-priests of the mire, travelers leave offerings before crossing low peat-and-clay hollows inland.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.21: Out beyond the rope-bridge port city, coastal mangrove roots and groves of the Wilderking's corrupted servants test anyone who wanders off the beaten track.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.22: Every season in Greenshade is measured by rolling salt fog off the Abecean and the flow of Gathongor's Mire and Verrant Morass.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.23: The factors who handle shipping with Summerset and Senchal say the forest guardian no longer answers the Spinners has doubled the price of guards along sheltered harbour sound.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.24: No mason in Greenshade forgets the burning of the western Ayleid city when laying foundations over subsided beaches and mangrove estuaries on the western sea.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.25: If you seek work in Greenshade, look to bay and estuary fisheries or sign on with the wardens watching burned Ayleid citadel.
society.skycraft.say.greenshade.26: Old songs in a marsh town inside a hollow tree still name each Wilderking chosen from a mortal host and the vows of the living spirit-throne of the western woods.
